premises.text: There is no affordable way to decarbonize heavy industries.
premises.evidence_span: There is no affordable way to decarbonize our heavy industries.

premises.text: Decarbonizing heat requires energy that is cheap, reliable, and hot.
premises.evidence_span: That energy needs to be cheap, reliable, and hot, often hot as flames.

premises.text: Current zero carbon options are not affordable when made reliable.
premises.evidence_span: As soon as you try to make them reliable, being cheap is already incredible, but when you try to make them reliable to power, say, a 24-7 cement plant, you 6x the cost.

premises.text: The Joule Hive Thermal Battery can provide reliable industrial heat from renewable energy.
premises.evidence_span: This system takes in electricity from renewables or off-peak nuclear hydro whenever it's cheap, whenever it's abundant, whenever it's available.

premises.text: The Joule Hive can deliver heat at temperatures comparable to hydrogen but at a lower cost.
premises.evidence_span: we can do this hot as they need, 1800 Celsius, the same as hydrogen say, but we can keep it affordable, at least three times cheaper than hydrogen.

premises.text: The Joule Hive is retrofittable to existing industrial processes.
premises.evidence_span: we can attach to your existing process, pipe in our hot gas, to your furnace, your boiler, even your turbine.

premises.text: Electrically conductive fire bricks are a key technology for the Joule Hive.
premises.evidence_span: the electrically conductive fire brick, or e-bricks if you like.

premises.text: The Joule Hive can scale to meet industrial heat demands.
premises.evidence_span: we'll be building products soon on the shipping container-sized scale. But ultimately, we're building to tall towers that can put out hundreds of megawatts of heat.

premises.text: Electricity prices can be cheaper than natural gas for heating in certain areas.
premises.evidence_span: you can operate in areas today where 50% of the year, electricity is cheaper than natural gas as a heat source.

premises.text: The Joule Hive can offset a significant portion of carbon emissions.
premises.evidence_span: we can pay back in five years while offsetting 80% of your carbon emissions.

value.text: Heavy industries can decarbonize affordably and reliably with electrified heat.
value.evidence_span: we're working every day to decarbonize the hottest industries with electrified heat.

notes: Customer traction and future revenue projections are excluded as traction.
